question: What is the Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act, 2003?

options.text: It is concerned with the reduction in the fiscal deficit of up to 3% of the GDP.
It is related to the increase in the capital expenditure.
It is related to the increase in government expenditure in some proportion.
It is concerned with the increase in the fiscal deficit of up to 5% of the GDP.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It is concerned with the reduction in the fiscal deficit of up to 3% of the GDP.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The **Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act, 2003** is concerned with** the reduction in the fiscal deficit of up to 3% of the GDP**.
 
• **FRBM Act or Fiscal ****Responsibility and Budgeting Management Act 2003** was formed by the** Indian Parliament to institutionalize fiscal stability, reduce the fiscal deficit, and enhance macroeconomic stability**.
 
• Its main objective was to achieve** fiscal stability and to give the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) flexibility to deal with inflation in India**.
 
• It targeted to reduce the **country's fiscal deficit to 3% of GDP by March 2008**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Its deadlines have been extended **several times due to different reasons**.
 
• In May 2016, the government set up a committee under NK Singh to review the FRBM Act.
 
• The committee recommended that the **government should target a fiscal deficit of 3 percent of the GDP in years up to March 31, 2020, cut it to 2.8 percent in 2020-21, and to 2.5 percent by 2023**.
 
• It was introduced by **India's then-Finance Minister, Mr. Yashwant Sinha under Prime Minister Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee in December 2000**.
 
• The bill was passed on **26 August 2003 and came into force in July 2004**.
